description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named EmployeeLeaveSearchFilterParams, used for specifying filter parameters when searching for employee leave records within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It extends another class called LeaveSearchFilterParams, includes traits for leave request services, and provides attributes and setter/getter methods for filtering by date range, employee number, leave statuses, and inclusion criteria.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering employee leave records based on date range, status, employee number, and inclusion criteria, extending the base LeaveSearchFilterParams class.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Returns the array of leave statuses used in filtering.

methods.name: setStatuses
methods.description: Sets the leave statuses for filtering after validating against the allowed statuses list.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date for the leave filter range.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for the leave filter range.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Retrieves the end date for the leave filter range.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for the leave filter range.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number associated with the filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the leave filter.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the inclusion criteria string specifying which employees are included.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the inclusion criteria for filtering employees.
